item.title: ‘Chipping away at the rights of Iowans’: House passes bill to eliminate local civil rights protections for trans people
item.description: On Thursday, the Iowa House approved a bill that prohibits local governments from having any civil rights ordinances that provide greater protections for rights than state law does. Eliminating the power of local governments to protect the rights of transgender and nonbinary people is one of Gov. Kim Reynolds’ stated priorities for her final legislative session as governor.
